stars.csv.adql:
SELECT g.source_id,g.ra,g.dec,g.pmra,g.pmdec,g.parallax,g.parallax_over_error,
       g.phot_g_mean_mag,g.bp_rp,g.ruwe,g.duplicated_source,g.teff_gspphot
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',180,30,2))
AND g.parallax>=3.333333333333334 AND g.parallax_over_error>=10
AND g.phot_g_mean_mag<17 AND g.bp_rp BETWEEN 0.5 AND 3.5
ORDER BY g.source_id

field_count.csv.adql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',g.ra,g.dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',180,30,2))
AND g.parallax>=3.333333333333334 AND g.parallax_over_error>=10
AND g.phot_g_mean_mag<17 AND g.bp_rp BETWEEN 0.5 AND 3.5
